name: posthog
description: Connects the site to PostHog product analytics through the PostHog provider plugin in the same package (analytics-posthog). Ships the know-how and a secure key card: the assistant opens the card, the person picks the region (US by default, EU or a self-hosted URL) and pastes the project API key, and the host saves it to your project, and you choose which sites use it. No PostHog code here; the provider plugin sends the events.
author: Tovu

tovu.summary: Sends your site's product analytics to PostHog. Ask the assistant to connect PostHog.

credentialCards.title: Connect PostHog
credentialCards.label: PostHog
credentialCards.intro: Send this site's product analytics to PostHog.
usedFor: Sends product analytics events to your PostHog project
credentialCards.keyHint: In PostHog open Project settings and copy the Project API key (starts with phc_).
